name: Hart Grancer
source: Regardless of who his opponent is, Hart always insists on looking down on them. Despite acting like a big shot, hei is completely reliant on his guardian, Spiano. In other words, he is a useless person. He often tries to become independent but isn't able to hold a job for long because of his high pride. Thanks to that, his debt keeps raising and raising. He has the ability to discern lies.
